verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirmed a keyless JSON API for Colorado business-entity data (HTTP 200 from data.colorado.gov's Socrata endpoint), so read-only registry lookups can be scripted headlessly or run in CI. The documented Intelligence Center and data-request offerings support this bulk data access. However, the core registry actions (entity filings, name reservations, periodic reports, good-standing certificates) are only evidenced as web forms and PDFs, with no programmatic or headless filing path. Missing for 10: API or automation path for filings and transactions, first-party API/CLI documentation for CI use, authentication or rate-limit guidance, and independent corroboration beyond a single probe GET.
